headline: Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar ordered strict action against hoarding, artificial shortages and overpricing of essential commodities after a cabinet committee in Islamabad was told stocks are adequate with no shortages anticipated.

card.desc: Officials told DPM Dar stocks are adequate, no shortages anticipated

caption:
Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar ordered strict action against hoarding, artificial shortages and overpricing of essential commodities, The Express Tribune and Dawn reported. Chairing a cabinet committee in Islamabad, he was told stocks are adequate, with no shortages anticipated and prices stabilising.
